title: Welcome to My Finances
intro: Start by adding your first account, for example your main checking account. Its opening balance and date are the starting point for tracking: everything you record afterwards is added on top of it. You can add more accounts later, and pick a real institution now or keep "No institution".
categoriesIntro: Here are some common categories to start with, already checked. Uncheck any you don't want, and add your own below.
editLaterNote: You can add, rename or remove categories anytime later from Settings.
